# Founder Email Finder

> Guides and a tool for finding a company founder's or owner's email from the company's own website. The tool runs on Apify: https://apify.com/intropi/company-contacts-tech-lookup

What the tool does: you paste websites (or give a Google Maps dataset ID, or pick a Singapore industry from the official ACRA register). For each company it returns the founder or owner's name and email, labelled "published on site", "guessed from site email format" or "guessed (common format)"; the best company email; phone numbers; LinkedIn and other profiles; and the tech stack. It reads only the company's own website; it has no email database and never checks a guess by sending mail.

Price: $1.50 per 1,000 companies; $5 per 1,000 for the Singapore industry search. Rows with nothing found are free. Apify gives $5 of free credit every month (about 3,333 companies). Hunter.io, for comparison: $49 per month for 2,000 credits, 50 free credits a month (as reported Oct-Nov 2026).

Measured: founder email guesses exactly right for 70% of 189 real people (76% when the site shows its email format). On 63 small-business websites against the most-used Apify contact scraper: emails 57 vs 51, phones 54 vs 40, wrong-organisation emails 5 vs 22, 81 s vs 416 s. Known weak spot: in a test on 5 dental practice sites it found no owner names.
